name: Nneka Tavaré-Hajduk
role: Gym trainer and boxing instructor, community fitness cooperative
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone — the Ironbody Cooperative, second floor of a reclaimed factory building
description:
Nneka is built like someone who decided what she was going to be and then spent twenty years becoming it — wide through the shoulders, with forearms that look carved, and a jaw that suggests she has never backed down from anything that didn't have a very good reason to ask. Her skin is very dark and very smooth except for the scar tissue along her left cheekbone from a fight she doesn't discuss and the chevron pattern of elective scarification across both shoulders that echoes her grandmother's ceremonial markings, done at a body modification studio in Geartown with deliberate care. Her hair is kept in tight plaits close to her skull. She has retractable reinforced knuckle implants — the only chrome on her body, practical not cosmetic, and she got them after the third time she broke her hand hitting something harder than she should have.

The Ironbody Cooperative runs on a sliding scale: you pay what you can, you work what you owe in facility maintenance if you can't, and you don't cause problems for other members or you leave. Nneka runs it with two other trainers and a rotating volunteer roster. She teaches children's boxing on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, adult conditioning circuits five days a week, and one private session per week with whoever needs it most — she charges more for the private sessions with people who can afford it and uses that margin to subsidize the cooperative's equipment costs. She believes, with the ferocity of someone who was saved by it, that physical discipline is the most democratic thing a person can practice.

core_fears: That the HPAZ's autonomy is temporary and she will watch it be absorbed the same way her mother's neighborhood was
That the children she trains will grow up and still have nowhere to go
core_desires: For the cooperative to outlast her — to become something that doesn't need her anymore
To be believed when she says a person is worth believing in
coping_mechanisms: Physical exertion as emotional regulation — she trains harder when she is worried
Turning private anger into public utility: her best lessons come when she's furious about something
blind_spots: She is ferociously loyal to the HPAZ and occasionally cannot see when the autonomous zone's politics are being manipulated by people with agendas she doesn't share
She assumes everyone is capable of the same discipline she has, and is genuinely surprised when they are not
psychology.secret: One of her regular adult students is a Ferrogate Transit middle manager she knows is feeding information about HPAZ activity patterns to the transit authority's security division. She has not confronted them because she is not sure what she would do. She is getting closer to sure.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Blunt, action-oriented, no softening language. Mixes Nigerian English cadences with HPAZ community dialect. Technical about the body — very specific about muscles, form, breath.
speech_patterns.cadence: Declarative. Short sentences when teaching. Longer, slower sentences when she's thinking something through out loud, which she does rarely.
verbal_tics: 'Where are your feet?' (when someone is scared or unfocused, literal and metaphorical)
Clicking her reinforced knuckles when thinking
example_lines: 'I don't train killers. I train people who are done being afraid. Those are different things. Come back when you know which one you are.'
'The cooperative doesn't ask what you did before you walked in. It asks what you're going to do while you're here. That's all.'
'You want to hurt something? Fine. Hurt this bag. Hurt it correctly. There's a difference.'

story_hooks: The Ferrogate informant in her gym — Nneka needs someone to help her figure out the scope of what's been disclosed before she makes a move

A thirteen-year-old she coaches has gotten tangled with one of the HPAZ's less reputable mutual aid networks — the kind that runs guns alongside food — and Nneka wants to extract the kid without burning the network entirely

The cooperative's building title is being contested by a Palladian subsidiary that acquired the debt on the original reclamation paperwork — Nneka needs legal help she cannot afford and physical backup she's hoping she won't need
narrative_function: Community defender and moral voice. A source of physical training resources for characters who need conditioning. Represents the HPAZ's spirit of collective self-reliance. Can provide safe harbor, reliable muscle if circumstances demand it, and a sharp ethical perspective.
augmentations: Retractable reinforced knuckle plating (functional, not cosmetic). Elective scarification (non-augmentation body modification).
daily_life: Up at 0500 for her own training, opens the cooperative at 0630, teaches back-to-back sessions until early afternoon, spends evenings doing equipment maintenance or attending Highland Park community meetings.
affiliation: Ironbody Cooperative — Highland Park Autonomous Zone community institution

decision_rules: Protect the children in the cooperative first, always
Never throw the first punch but make very sure there is no second one
If someone is honest about what they need, find a way to give it to them
escalation_ladder: Direct statement of the problem, no threats
Physical positioning — she will stand in the way, literally
She is very good at what she does

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing, physically present, waits to see what they lead with
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm but not soft — she expresses care through attention and honesty, not comfort

stress_responses.medium: Becomes extremely focused on the immediate physical environment — checking exits, positioning, the room
stress_responses.high: Calm settles over her like a drop in temperature. People who know her find this more frightening than anger.

contradictions: She teaches discipline and collective responsibility and she has been running a private anger she has told no one about for years
habits: Tapes her knuckles even on rest days out of habit
Eats the same post-training meal: rice, black-eyed peas, sardines in oil
Checks in on every child student's school attendance through informal networks
breaking_points: If a child she is responsible for is harmed because she waited too long to act on the informant situation, she will not forgive herself — and she will not be careful

cyberware_inventory.name: Retractable reinforced knuckle plating — both hands, medical-grade ceramic composite, installed after repeated hand fractures
